s.v: Is there a Country Customs Compliance Lead (CCCL), endorsed by the Country Senior Management Team (SMT)?
Does the CCCL have at least one (1) Individual Key Objective (IKO) related to Customs Compliance?
Are the local procedures documented and up-to-date (as outlined on Annex 1 of the Policy), to ensure compliance with Customs Regulations?
Are there internal awareness communications (regarding Customs Compliance) developed & released internally on a periodic basis?
Are changes in Customs Regulations timely identified, communicated, and implemented operationally?
Are the areas of improvement identified during the Country Self-Assessment documented on a Country Action Plan (with clear responsibilities & timelines)?
Have the relevant DHL Express Customs personnel received a Country-Specific Customs Operational & Customs Regulatory Training, with a training log created and monitored regularly?
Are Fines & Penalties (or Customs Debt) received from Customs Authorities recorded, monitored & managed locally, including updates in relevant DHL Financial Systems?
Are there Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans in place to reduce / mitigate / avoid recurrent systemic issues identified (which led to Fines & Penalties or Customs Debt)?

Are Fines & Penalties (or Customs Debt) with a value equal or above €10,000 EUR for a single incident (or with a value equal or above €50,000 EUR for a number of incidents of one type within a year) periodically reported to the RCCH (minimum monthly)?

Are Fines & Penalties (or Customs Debt) with a value equal or above €100,000 EUR against DHL Express in connection with a single incident or repeated incidents within a year (and/or violations representing a potential or imminent suspension or removal of a Customs privilege, license, or DHL Express ability to perform Customs services in a country) immediately escalated to the RCCH?
Are potential Voluntary Disclosures pre-aligned and signed-off by the Country Senior Management Team (SMT), GBS Legal, and the CCCL prior submission to Customs Authorities?
Are there Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans in place to reduce / mitigate / avoid recurrent of systemic issues (which led to the Voluntary Disclosure)?

Are payments related to Voluntary Disclosures with a value equal or above €10,000 EUR for a single disclosure (or with a value equal or above €50,000 EUR for a number of disclosures of one type within a year) periodically reported to the RCCH (minimum monthly)?

Are payments related to Voluntary Disclosures with value equal or above €100,000 EUR in connection with a single voluntary disclosure or repeated disclosures within a year (and/or disclosures that may result in a potential or imminent suspension or removal of a Customs privilege, license, or DHL Express ability to perform Customs services in a country) immediately escalated to the RCCH and requested sign-off (pre-approval prior the Voluntary Disclosure)?
Are communications with Customs & Other Government Authorities done in a professionally, accurately & timely manner, approved by DHL stakeholders outlined in the Policy, followed-up & archived?
Are inquiries, requests, issues or investigations regarding compliance with Customs Regulations that may affect the DHL Express’ ability to operate escalated internally (as per the Policy)?

Are Audits and In-Person Visits (planned or unannounced) conducted by Customs & Other Government Authorities immediately notified to relevant parties (as per the Policy), documented with clear meeting minutes /meeting report and follow-up actions agreed?
Has DHL Express obtained the AEO – or equivalent – certification, and maintains the certification status?
Are changes in the AEO – or equivalent – certification status (or if certification is at risk) notified to the RCCH?
Are customer contracts (with non-standard Customs-related clauses) raised to the Country Customs Customer Support Lead and GBS Legal for review and approval?
Are the Licenses & Permits to operate reviewed on a periodic basis (minimum once a year) to ensure that DHL Express complies with the conditions/requirements stated in a license or permit?
Are the requirements outlined in the country bonded facility authorization reviewed on a periodic basis (minimum once a year) to ensure that DHL Express complies with the conditions/requirements?
Is there a reconciliation inventory control in place, including inventory reconciliation performed at least twice per week (with action plan in case of systemic issues identified)?

Are there controls in place to ensure that Customs systems developments /changes are not creating compliance issues (including controls in case of automations in place, e.g., RPA/Robotic Process Automation)?

Is there a system documentation (including controls in case of automations in place, e.g., RPA/Robotic Process Automation) and system contingency plan (in case of system malfunction and/or system failure - also agreed with Customs Authorities)?

Are the user access right controls (of the country Customs Systems & Applications) in place and up-to-date? _x000a_(e.g., access granted only to authorized active DHL users and authorized representative from Customs Authorities)

Do the DHL Express employees performing Customs activities have the required qualification?_x000a_If a Customs Agent License (individual license per employee) is required by Customs Regulations, are there controls in place to ensure that employees have a valid license in place?

Are the required documents signed, dated and uploaded on the DHL Express Third Party Broker SharePoint (plus broker also logged in the country’s Vendor Master Database/VMD) as outlined in the 'Overview – Due Diligence of Third Party Brokers' process document (as per Policy section 3.5)?

Are Third Party Brokers periodically reviewed (minimum once a year) to ensure that the contractual requirements, operational performance and KPIs are met (including transactional-level audits of Customs Declarations)?
Are import/export/transit customs clearance records retained in an orderly and accessible manner for a minimum of five (5) years, or in accordance with regulations (whichever is longer)?

If allowed (as per Customs Regulations), are Pre-Arrival Customs Declarations processed and timely submitted to Customs Authorities prior to physical arrival of shipments, with complete and accurate information as per Customs Regulations requirements? - including (but not limited to) Incoterms®, Customs Value, Tariff Classification, Country of Origin, etc.
Are Manifests timely transmitted to Customs Authorities with complete and accurate information as per Customs Regulations requirements?
Are manifest discrepancies identified, logged in a report, and addressed to Customs Authorities (if required by Customs Regulations/Authorities)?
Are import shipments compliantly allocated into the correct De Minimis / Low Value / High Value categorization (as per the Customs Regulations requirements)?

Are Import Customs declarations timely transmitted to Customs Authorities with complete and accurate information as per Customs Regulations requirements? - including (but not limited to) Incoterms®, Customs Value, Tariff Classification, Country of Origin, etc.

Are Import Customs Declarations of high-risk/sensitive goods (such as anti-dumping, high-value goods, and other high-risk profiles defined locally) reviewed by (at least) two (2) qualified employees prior to the submission to Customs Authorities?
Are Corrective and Preventive Action Plans (CAPA) requested in case of systemic non-compliant Undervalued (UV) shipments identified?

Are Broker Handover instructions (obtained from customers to handover shipments to their nominated broker) received by the Customs Operations Team and archived in the applicable DHL system(s) – e.g., Customer Master File?
Are there controls in place to ensure that Prohibited Goods are identified during the Customs Clearance process (and handed over to Customs Authorities)?
Are there controls in place to ensure shipments with Restricted Goods are not released without the licenses /permits required by Regulations?
Are Corrective and Preventive Action Plans (CAPA) requested in case of systemic non-compliant Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) infringement shipments identified?
Are there controls in place to ensure that Transit / Bonded Movement shipments are accurately and timely declared to Customs Authorities?
Are the DHL guarantees (related to Transit / Bonded Movements) in place (as per Customs Regulations), with sufficient coverage?
Are controls in place to ensure compliant Temporary Imports/Exports declarations to Customs Authorities?
Are there controls in place to ensure that Post Clearance Modifications (PCM) are filed, monitored for progress, and followed-up until closure?
Is there a root cause assessment performed for Post Clearance Modifications (PCM) and definition of Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans for systemic issues to prevent reoccurrence?
Are there controls in place to ensure that Diplomatic Shipments identified & processed in accordance with Customs Regulations and Global SOP requirements?
Are there controls in place to ensure that Duties & Taxes are paid accurately & timely to Customs Authorities (as per Customs Regulations)?
Are there controls in place to identify and stop Unauthorized Release (URL) shipments from leaving the facility unauthorized?

Is there a root cause assessment performed for systemic issues that led to Unauthorized Releases (URL), and definition of Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans for systemic issues to prevent reoccurrence?
Are Export Customs declarations timely transmitted to Customs Authorities with complete and accurate information as per Customs Regulations requirements?

Are Export Customs Declarations of high-risk/sensitive goods (such as high-value goods, and other high-risk profiles defined locally) reviewed by (at least) two (2) qualified employees prior to the submission to Customs Authorities?
Is there a Reconciliation process/report in place to identify discrepancies between the actual physical shipment flow and the data (to ensure compliance with Customs Regulations)?

Is there a root cause assessment performed for systemic issues identified based on the reconciliation discrepancies, and definition of Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans for systemic issues identified to prevent repetition of errors?
Is there a Quality Review in place performed for at least 2% of the Formal Export/Import declarations (performed either on a daily or weekly basis)?

Is there a root cause assessment performed based on the systemic issues identified during the Quality Review, and definition of Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans for systemic issues identified to prevent repetition of errors?

Is DHL Express currently acting as IOR/EOR (or sub-contract a Third Party IOR/EOR Service Provider) for DHL own’s Customs purposes if operationally required (as per DHL Express’ own strategic decision) and/or legally required (as per Customs Regulations)? - e.g., for Low Value shipments where Customs Regulations allow.

Are Power of Attorneys (PoA) – or equivalent authorizations - collected from exporters/importers, and archived on the country’s DHL system(s) – e.g., Customer Master File (CMF) - with the respective expiration date (where applicable), as per Customs Regulations requirements?

Are there controls in place to ensure that Material Violations of Customs Regulations or this Policy are reported and investigated (as outlined on the Policy section 6)?_x000a_NOTE: 'Material Violation' is defined on section 1.6 (Definitions) of the Policy.

Are actual issues (or potential concerns) related to Customs Compliance escalated by the Country Customs Compliance Lead (CCCL) to the Country Senior Management Team (SMT) and to the Regional Customs Compliance Head (RCCH), as outlined in the Policy?
